t.E280.agn: In 2014 EFSA stated that the data did not allow an acceptable daily intake (ADI) to be set, but that there would be no safety concern at the authorised uses and maximum levels.
t.E280.body: Propionic acid is a fatty acid that gut bacteria also produce when digesting fibre, and it is used in the body for energy metabolism.
t.E280.prod: Mostly produced by chemical synthesis from petrochemical raw materials; its salts are obtained by neutralising the acid.
t.E280.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no ADI could be set, no safety concern at authorised use levels.
t.E280.summary: An organic acid that also forms naturally in cheese. It prevents mould in bread and bakery products.
t.E280.what: It is a preservative that delays mould growth in bread and bakery products.
